<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param '
    <!ENTITY ent "parsed entity value">
    <!ENTITY % subparam "<!ELEMENT nested (#PCDATA)>">
    %subparam;
  '>
  %param;
  <?pi-target pi-data?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2">
  <!-- Comment containing another comment-like structure -->
  <ns2:child ns2:id="1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA block with entity reference &ent; inside ]]>
  </ns2:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "RootEntity">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "http://example.com/external.ent">
  <!ENTITY % extpar SYSTEM "http://example.com/param.ent">
  %extpar;
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://xml.example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- First comment block -->
  <item xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="#item1">
    <?target-instruction data="value"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed CDATA section with <tags> and &base; reference.
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&base; and &ext;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record+)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % p1 "<!ENTITY ent1 'value1'>">
  <!ENTITY % p2 "<!ENTITY ent2 '&ent1; value2'>">
  %p1;
  %p2;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <?custom-pi processing instruction data?>
]>
<archive xmlns="urn:archive:schema" xmlns:meta="urn:archive:meta">
  <!-- Multi-line comment 
       covering multiple lines with special chars <>&'" -->
  <meta:record id="rec1">
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Nested-looking comment inside CDATA -->
      <meta:data>&ent2;</meta:data>
    ]]>
  </meta:record>
  <record>&ent2;</record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % dtdMacro "<!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA | sub)*>">
  %dtdMacro;
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY special "Special & character entity">
  <?xml-debug level="high" mode="verbose"?>
]>
<document xmlns="http://doc.org/ns" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Comment detailing namespace and entity usage -->
  <section xmlns="http://doc.org/ns/sub">
    <?pi-in-sub processing?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing markup: <section>test</section>
    ]]>
    <sub>&special;</sub>
  </section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE enterprise [
  <!ELEMENT enterprise (department*)>
  <!ELEMENT department (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY entA "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY entB "Beta &entA;">
  <!ENTITY entC "Gamma &entB;">
  <!ENTITY % ext-macro "<!ENTITY entD 'Delta'>">
  %ext-macro;
  <?enterprise-config status="active"?>
]>
<enterprise xmlns="http://enterprise.org/schema" xmlns:hr="http://enterprise.org/hr">
  <!-- Top-level enterprise comment -->
  <hr:department id="hr01">
    <?hr-pi audit="pending"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Confidential CDATA payload: &entC; with <xml> tags.
    ]]>
  </hr:department>
  <department>&entC; &entD;</department>
</enterprise>
```
